summary.zh: 修复 OAuth 登录在授权后停留在登录页的问题：登录状态现已由正确的实例驱动，完整登录链路可用。
summary.en: Fixed OAuth sign-in stalling on the login page after authorization: the login state is now driven by the correct instance end to end.

items.zh: 修复授权完成后界面无响应、无法进入应用的问题
items.en: Fixed the UI not reacting after completing authorization

items.zh: 修复应用运行中从浏览器返回时 OAuth 回调被丢弃的问题
items.en: Fixed OAuth callbacks dropped when returning from the browser while the app was running
